card.name: Last piece of sacubitril in ACE inhibitor warnings
card.fires_on: The final piece "il" of sacubitril, in warnings that ACE inhibitors must not be combined with a neprilysin inhibitor. It also fires weakly on a few words in serious-infection or pneumonia warnings.
